authorization: 2026-11-04 resumed sustained research-to-paper delivery; this preparation still requires distinct finite admission
signal_price: Forward total-return index from raw closes and reviewed ex-date cash distributions; same accepted arithmetic as study12, no future adjustment.
entry: At close immediately before first_session then every five sessions: signal_price>SMA120 and normalized MACD(12,26,9) histogram>0; pressure variant additionally requires signed amount pressure20>0; next-session raw open only.
exit: Every close: two consecutive signal_price<SMA120 closes, or any required signal input unknown; next-session open. MACD/pressure turning nonpositive alone does not exit. No same-open roundtrip or topup.
unknown: Retain all dates and unknowns; no entry, close active signal episode next open.
sizing: Prior close, prior20 ADV, 100-share lots, include fee. Reject whole entry if next-open all-in cost>800; no resize/retry. Close value>900 schedules whole-lot sale toward800 at next open; refresh each close. Gap/blocked exit above1000 remains a breach and permanently stops new entries.
holding: Same asset, capital,800 entry budget,900/800 trim,1000 hard cap,costs,calendar and permanent stop. Exit after252 sessions or terminal; next-session renewal; occupied/failed entry skipped without retry. Cash has zero interest. Fixed controls before any outcome.

uncertainty.method: paired circular block bootstrap on continuous evaluation account daily PnL and strategy-minus-holding
uncertainty.correction: Bonferroni across4 prospective comparisons; this does not erase earlier study selection

selection_policy: Report all4 and all108 accounts; no outcome-driven threshold/cost/sign/window selection or resetting halted accounts.
limitations: Two selected surviving ETFs; not population inference
Historical versions and publication timing conditional
Daily volume only ex-post feasibility for modeled open fills
Stops and buffers cannot guarantee caps across gaps
opening_risk_observation: Before fills, mark carried positions at raw open. Any value above1000 is retained as a breach and permanently blocks new entries. Existing planned trim/exit may execute; a newly required risk exit is submitted for the following session, never manufactured at the same observed open.
